description:
End one hire. The rest of the bounty keeps running. You get back what the cancellation rules allow.
Use for: ending a hire before work is submitted. If confirmation_required, call again within 5 minutes with hireId, confirmationToken from cancellation.confirmation.token, and the same idempotencyKey. If processing, retry with the same key. Read cancellation.refund for the refund quote, or cancellation.held for where the held money went.
Not for: ending the whole bounty (cancel_bounty); work that was not done (open_dispute).
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: cancel_hire({"hireId":"a3Fh8kQz1WpL0mNc","idempotencyKey":"5f0c7a2e-8d4b-4e1a-9c3f-2b6d1e8a7f40"})
Key: the idempotencyKey in the example is a sample. Replace it with a new unique key for each new call, and keep that key for the call’s retries and any confirmation it asks for.
Repeat: A repeat with the same input, and the same key if you sent one, does not act twice: it returns the same result, finishes the first call, or is refused.
Errors: not_cancellable, only_spot, submission_waiting, confirmation_expired, refund_changed, cancellation_in_progress, idempotency_key_reused; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

confirmationToken.description: The token of a confirmation_required reply. Send it with hireId and the same idempotencyKey within 5 minutes to carry out that cancellation. Default: none, which asks to end the hire.

hireId.description: The hire id, from list_hires or accept_application.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique string for this call. Repeat it when you retry, so the call runs once.

name: cancel_hire

actions.description: Tools you may call on this hire now. Each tool still checks. Left out when there are none, and when status is left out: then read the hire with get_hire.

confirmation.description: Set only when status is confirmation_required.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

held.description: Where the money held for this hire went, when the hire was ended outside the cancellation rules (refund is left out then). The worker keeps none of it. Left out when refund is set, or when the stored record could not be read: then get_wallet and list_wallet_transactions show what came back.

card.description: The part given back to the card that paid it.

total.description: What was held for this hire when it ended.

unfilledSpots.description: The part that stays held on the bounty for the spot this hire left open: not in your wallet. Accepting another applicant uses it; cancel_bounty gives it back.

wallet.description: The part that came back to your wallet.

kept.description: Left out exactly when refund is left out.

serviceFee.description: What is kept as service fee, not given back.

workerPay.description: What the worker is paid for the hire, not given back.

refund.description: Left out when the hire was ended outside the cancellation rules: then held says how much was held and where it went.

bonuses.description: The part of total that is bonus money nobody earned.

total.description: What the cancellation gives back to you, bonuses included. Your wallet is credited with it once status is cancelled.

status.description: confirmation_required: call again within 5 minutes with hireId, confirmationToken from cancellation.confirmation.token, and the same idempotencyKey. processing: the cancellation is saved and its money steps are not finished; call again with the same key to finish them. cancelled: the hire is ended.

endedReason.description: Why the hire ended, once it has. Left out while it has not ended, and when status is left out because the hire could not be read after this call.

payStatus.description: Left out only when the hire could not be read after this call: then status, payStatus and actions are all left out. Read it with get_hire.

status.description: Left out only when the hire could not be read after this call: then status, payStatus and actions are all left out. Read it with get_hire.

title: Cancel a hire
